query.description: The contact's email address. A request to update a contact's email address does not immediately update the value. Instead, an email change request flow is initiated, sending notifications to both the old and new email addresses. The value will be updated when the change is confirmed via a link sent to the new email address.
Contact status - "enabled" allows the contact to conduct activity on the sub-account, "not_enabled" disables the contact. (This can only be one of enabled,not_enabled)
Contact's date of birth. ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD. Required if account type is individual.
